# Qt 6 desktop build only (the MCU build uses core.qmlproject).
# Generated by tools/sync_project_files.py.
set_source_files_properties(Theme.qml Router.qml Format.qml PROPERTIES QT_QML_SINGLETON_TYPE TRUE)

qt_add_library(cluster_core STATIC)
qt_add_qml_module(cluster_core
    URI ClusterCore
    VERSION 1.0
    OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${EVB_QML_OUT}/ClusterCore
    QML_FILES
        Theme.qml
        Router.qml
        Format.qml
)
